item.wind_armor.description: Light chest armor of overlapping gray plates that flutter and shift like feathers.
item.wind_armor.lore: Salvaged from the glider crash site, where someone fell for a very long time. The armor remembers moving fast.
item.wind_armor.name: Wreckwing Cuirass
item.wind_armor.unique: Dodging an attack gives +20% movement speed, +35% damage and +2000 armor, and heals 5% of your maximum life.
item.withered_crown.description: A crown of dry thorny twigs, brittle and gray, with dark stains in the bark.
item.withered_crown.lore: The doomsday cult's idea of royalty. It still catches blood, and what it catches does not stay put.
item.withered_crown.name: Ashthorn Circlet
item.withered_crown.unique: One cast of Blood Infused Arrow affects 4 additional projectiles.
item.wonderful_feather.description: A shimmering feather that shifts between green and violet as you turn it.

perk.more_health_regen.flavor: The body mends itself, given a minute.

perk.more_limbs.effect: +10 carry capacity for arms, legs, heads and head bombs per stack.
perk.more_limbs.flavor: Don't ask what the bag is for.

perk.more_meat.effect: +5 carry capacity for all meats per stack.
perk.more_meat.name: Meat Locker
perk.more_meds.name: Gauze Lining
perk.more_miscellaneous_items.effect: +5 carry capacity for pots, shells, watches, circuit boards, air canisters and flares per stack.
perk.more_miscellaneous_items.flavor: Nobody knows when a spare flare saves you.
perk.more_miscellaneous_items.name: Junk Drawer
perk.more_snacks.effect: +20 carry capacity for candy bars and sodas per stack.
perk.more_snacks.name: Sugar Stash
perk.more_stamina.effect: Each point of Agility adds 0.5 max stamina.
perk.more_stamina.name: Second Wind
perk.multishot_empower.effect: +2 projectiles for multishot per stack. Increases the spell's cost. Does not apply to spears.
perk.multishot_empower.name: Volley Surge
perk.near_death_arrow.effect: Blood infused arrow costs 25% more health to convert into damage.
perk.near_death_arrow.flavor: Spend the blood, win the fight.
perk.near_death_arrow.name: Desperate Draw
perk.near_death_experience.effect: Once every 5 minutes, fatal damage instead restores you to full health and grants 10 seconds of debuff immunity.
perk.near_death_experience.name: Last Breath
perk.netherflame.name: Pitchfire
perk.nuke_conjuration.effect: Ball Lightning can score critical hits.
perk.nuke_conjuration.name: Ball Lightning: Fork
perk.overcharge.effect: Spell damage is increased by 35% and spell costs by 70%, per stack.
perk.overcharge.name: Redline
perk.overwhelming_odds.flavor: Odds are for people who miss.
perk.overwhelming_odds.name: Vital Strike
perk.pantheon_of_champions.effect: Allies inside Healing Dome deal 20% more damage and take 70% less damage.
perk.pantheon_of_champions.flavor: Stand inside the ring and fight like it is the last day.
perk.pantheon_of_champions.name: Rally Ring
perk.parry_mastery.effect: Parry radius is +1 yard, and you can parry any type of enemy.
perk.parry_mastery.name: Open Guard

perk.piercing.name: Plate Splitter
perk.pistol_specialization.name: Sidearm Mastery
perk.pockets_for_explosives.effect: +15 carry capacity for bombs and dynamite per stack.
perk.pockets_for_explosives.flavor: Don't ask what's in the coat.
perk.pockets_for_explosives.name: Blasting Bandolier
perk.polishing.effect: Unlocks the Polishing tab at the crafting bench: shift a single stat up or down and empty sockets, for one item of equal or higher rarity.
perk.polishing.flavor: Sand the edges until the numbers shine.
perk.polishing.name: Fine Honing
perk.pound_of_flesh.flavor: Pay the debt in extra meat.
perk.pound_of_flesh.name: Flesh Surplus
perk.power_slowdown.effect: -10% attack speed but +1% all damage, per stack.
perk.power_slowdown.name: Heavy Hands
perk.power_slowdown_crit.effect: -10% projectile speed but +10% critical hit damage, per stack.
perk.power_slowdown_crit.flavor: Let it fly slower, land harder.
perk.power_slowdown_crit.name: Slow Release
perk.power_swing.effect: Melee attacks cost 40% more stamina and deal 25% more damage, per stack.
perk.power_swing.name: Haymaker
perk.projectile_damage.name: Barbed Payload
perk.pyromancy.effect: Fire damage ticks 20% faster on enemies, per stack. Stacks with other players.
perk.pyromancy.name: Kindler
perk.quick_silver.effect: Blink cooldown is reduced by 6 seconds.
perk.quick_silver.name: Vanishing Habit
perk.ranged_mastery.effect: +10% ranged damage, +300% headshot damage and +100% critical hit damage.
perk.ranged_mastery.flavor: Distance is just a measurement of skill.
perk.ranged_mastery.name: Marksman's Craft
perk.reforging.effect: Unlocks the Reforging tab at the crafting bench: trade 3 items of equal or higher rarity to turn an item into another of the same tier.
perk.reforging.flavor: Melt it down, hammer it into something better.
perk.reforging.name: Second Forge
perk.rejuvenation.effect: Restore 1 energy and 1.5 health on hit.
perk.rejuvenation.flavor: Every hit is a small mercy.
perk.rejuvenation.name: Wound Dividend
perk.rerolling.effect: Opens a crafting menu in your inventory. Reroll an item's properties by consuming 2 items of the same rarity.
perk.rerolling.name: Scrapbench Gamble
perk.rerolling_individual_stats.effect: Unlocks a crafting tab to reroll a single stat on an item and empty sockets, for one item of equal or higher rarity.
perk.rerolling_individual_stats.flavor: One stat at a time, like a butcher with a plan.
perk.rerolling_individual_stats.name: Chisel and Flux
perk.resource_cost_reduction.effect: Spell costs reduced by 9% per stack.
perk.resource_cost_reduction.name: Thrifty Spark
perk.restoration.effect: All healing and stamina and energy recovery is increased by 30%.
perk.restoration.name: Deep Recovery
perk.reusability_i.effect: 4% chance not to consume ammo when firing, per stack.
perk.reusability_i.name: Salvage I
perk.reusability_ii.effect: +13% chance not to consume ammo when firing.
perk.reusability_ii.flavor: Fewer misses left in the dirt.
perk.reusability_ii.name: Salvage II
perk.reusability_iii.effect: +13% chance not to consume ammo when firing.
perk.reusability_iii.flavor: Ammo goes a long way out here.
perk.reusability_iii.name: Salvage III
perk.safe_heaven.effect: Healing Dome lasts 50 seconds longer, for about a full minute.
perk.safe_heaven.flavor: A place to breathe, for once.
perk.safe_heaven.name: Warded Ground
perk.seeking_arrow_crippling_precision.e: Seeking arrow's slow lasts 6 seconds longer.
perk.seeking_arrow_crippling_precision.f: Slow them. Then finish the job.
perk.seeking_arrow_head_hunting.effect: Seeking arrow no longer suffers a damage penalty on headshots.
perk.seeking_arrow_head_hunting.flavor: The arrow finds the skull anyway.
perk.seeking_arrow_head_hunting.name: Seeking Arrow: Headtaker
perk.seeking_arrow_improved_memory.effec: Seeking Arrow keeps its target marked for 5 seconds longer.
perk.seeking_arrow_improved_memory.name: Seeking Arrow: Grudge
perk.seeking_arrow_movement_impairing_ar: Seeking arrow's slow is increased from 10% to 40%.
Barbed to bring prey to a crawl.
perk.shield_endurance.effect: Your shield doesn't decay for an extra 10 seconds, per stack.
perk.shield_endurance.flavor: A barrier that refuses to fade.
perk.shield_endurance.name: Shield: Stubborn Hold
perk.size_matters.effect: Projectile damage rises with projectile size.
perk.size_matters.name: Heavy Calibre
perk.skull_basher.effect: Bashed enemies take 35% more damage for as long as the bash slow lasts.
perk.skull_basher.flavor: Rattle the skull, soften the rest.
perk.skull_basher.name: Dentcrown
perk.skull_basher_ii.effect: Bashed enemies take 50% more damage instead, for as long as the bash slow lasts.
perk.skull_basher_ii.flavor: Now it rattles the bones too.
perk.skull_basher_ii.name: Bone Rattler
perk.sniper.effect: Projectiles deal 5% more damage for every meter they travel.
perk.sniper.name: Far Reach
perk.spear_gamble.effect: +15% chance for thrown spears to hit the head.
perk.spear_gamble.name: Wild Lob
perk.spear_mastery.flavor: The shaft only knows one direction.
perk.spear_mastery.name: Hurler's Edge
perk.spear_specialization.flavor: Throw it like you mean it.
perk.spear_specialization.name: Spearcaster
perk.spears.effect: +6% chance for double spears, per stack.
perk.spears.name: Spearstorm
perk.speed.flavor: Less flight time, less time to dodge.
perk.speed.name: Swift Flight
perk.speed_matters.effect: Projectile speed increases projectile crit damage.
perk.speed_matters.name: Velocity Bite
perk.spell_power.name: Raw Surge
perk.spikes.flavor: Wear the pointy bits on the outside.
perk.spikes.name: Nailstud
perk.steroid.flavor: Do not ask where it came from.
perk.steroid.name: Juiced Arms
perk.storm_of_the_century.effect: Ball Lightning damage scaling is increased by 4500%.
perk.storm_of_the_century.name: Walking Tempest
perk.storm_season.effect: Ball Lightning cooldown is reduced by 40 seconds.
perk.storm_season.name: Thunderclock
perk.stronger_hits.effect: Each point of Strength adds 1% melee damage.
perk.stronger_hits.flavor: Every rep on this island pays off.
perk.stronger_hits.name: Iron Knuckle
perk.stronger_projectiles.effect: Each point of Agility adds 1% ranged damage.
perk.stronger_projectiles.name: Steady Aim
perk.stronger_spells.effect: Each point of Intelligence adds 1% spell damage.
perk.stronger_spells.name: Searing Mind
perk.sudden_rampage.effect: Berserk cooldown is reduced by 90 seconds.
perk.sudden_rampage.name: Red Mist
perk.super_charged_attack.effect: Charged melee attacks deal 200% more damage.
perk.super_charged_attack.name: Skullsplitter
perk.supersonic.name: Snapflight
perk.target_practise.name: Range Drills
perk.temple_of_protection.effect: Healing Dome grants immunity to stun and root effects.
perk.temple_of_protection.flavor: Packed earth, thick walls, no way in.
perk.temple_of_protection.name: Stonewall Dome
perk.the_big_suck.effect: Black hole radius is +15 yards, roughly doubling it.
perk.the_big_suck.name: Hungry Dark
perk.the_real_armageddon.flavor: The last one fizzled. This one will not.
perk.the_real_armageddon.name: Scorched Earth
perk.thorny_skin.effect: Gain +2 thorns for every point of Strength. Thorns scale with melee damage multipliers.
perk.thorny_skin.name: Briar Hide
perk.thorny_skin_ii.effect: Gain thorns equal to 150% of your Vitality.
perk.thorny_skin_ii.name: Wirevein
perk.time_of_need.effect: Healing Dome and Purge cooldowns are reduced by 50%.
perk.time_of_need.flavor: Help arrives sooner than it should.
perk.time_of_need.name: Hasty Rescue
perk.transmutation.effect: 15% of spell costs are paid from stamina instead of energy.
perk.transmutation.flavor: Let the legs pay for the magic.
perk.transmutation.name: Sinew Channel
perk.transporter.effect: Lets you use your raft on land, turning it into a wooden hovercraft.
perk.transporter.name: Landskimmer
perk.true_aim.effect: Arrow headshots on enemies over 60 feet away (not seeking) hit twice and deal 50% more damage.
perk.true_aim.name: Distant Mark
perk.turbo.name: Overdriven Skimmer
perk.vitality.name: Hardy Frame
perk.warmth.effect: The slow from Blizzard is greatly reduced.
perk.warmth.flavor: Keep the cold where it belongs.
perk.warmth.name: Hearth Blood
perk.weaken.effect: Hits have a +7% chance to make the target take more damage, per stack.
perk.weaken.flavor: Find the crack and widen it.
perk.weaken.name: Exposed Flaw
perk.wrath_of_the_sun.effect: Sun Flare cooldown is reduced by 20 seconds.
perk.wrath_of_the_sun.name: Flarewright
set.akagi.bonus.1: Each piece: Snow Storm deals +0.5 damage multiplier.
set.akagi.bonus.2: Snow Storm pulls enemies toward its center.
set.akagi.bonus.4: Snow Storm hits twice as fast and gains +3 damage multiplier.
set.akagi.lore: Winter wears a human shape on the highest ridges. Those who take her clothes learn what she does with the cold.
set.akagi.name: Whiteout Regalia
set.back_nine.bonus.4: +50% crit damage, headshots deal +2 damage multiplier, +10% movement speed.
set.back_nine.lore: Eighteen holes, sixteen of them under water. Whoever finishes the back nine gets the clubhouse.
set.back_nine.name: Back Nine
set.berserk.bonus.1: Each piece: weapon range x1.3 and attacks cost half as much stamina.
set.berserk.bonus.5: A further +80% melee damage and +30% attack speed.
set.berserk.lore: A warrior's oath that eats its owner: reach farther, swing harder, and never stop to breathe.
set.berserk.name: Blood Oath
set.bunker_protocol.bonus.3: +15% ranged armor piercing and +2 energy per second.
set.bunker_protocol.bonus.5: True aim is active and headshots deal +2 damage multiplier.
set.bunker_protocol.lore: Sealed-door tech assembled by a hundred patient printers, still running a job nobody remembers ordering.
set.bunker_protocol.name: Bunker Protocol
set.fingers_of_the_fallen.bonus.2: +20% chance to bleed and +5 life on hit.
set.fingers_of_the_fallen.bonus.4: +25% chance to weaken and +40% heavy attack damage.
set.fingers_of_the_fallen.lore: Trophies from things that had too many fingers, worn by someone who now counts them.
set.fingers_of_the_fallen.name: Fingers of the Fallen
set.golden_aegis.bonus.5: Golden resolve is active and you are immune to stuns.
set.golden_aegis.lore: Gold that was never mined, heavier than it looks, warmer than it should be. Armor from somewhere under the hills.
set.golden_aegis.name: Buried Gold
set.hollow_congregation.bonus.3: Spells recharge 15% faster, Black Hole lasts 3 s longer.
set.hollow_congregation.bonus.5: Cataclysm turns arcane with +3 m radius, Black Hole gains +4 m radius.
set.hollow_congregation.lore: Quiet people in gray robes who stopped hearing the island's screams and started echoing them.
set.hollow_congregation.name: The Hushed
spell.ball_lightning.description: Releases a crackling orb that deals 1,220 base damage plus 75x spell damage, and can crit with the right gear. 350 energy, 100 s cooldown.
spell.ball_lightning.name: Ball Lightning
spell.bash.description: A shield-first slam that slows enemies by 40% for 2 s and makes them take 30% more damage. Gear adds bleed and lifesteal. 25 energy, 25 s cooldown.
spell.bash.name: Bash
spell.berserk.description: Fly into a 30 s rage: +30% damage, +35% movement speed and +25% attack speed, at the cost of your max health. 10 energy, 200 s cooldown.
spell.berserk.name: Berserk
spell.black_flame.description: Toggle a cold black fire that damages nearby enemies steadily, scaling with spell damage (x0.4). Keep it lit as long as your energy lasts. 25 energy, 2.5 s cooldown.
spell.black_flame.name: Black Flame
spell.black_hole.description: Tears open a 15 m gravity well for 9 s that drags enemies to its core and crushes them with heavy magic damage scaling with spell damage. 350 energy, 140 s cooldown.
spell.black_hole.name: Black Hole
spell.blink.description: Teleport up to 15 m in the direction you face. Great for dodging, awful for dignity. Gear can extend range or make arrival explosive. 25 energy, 14 s cooldown.
spell.blink.name: Blink
spell.blood_infused_arrow.description: Pay with your own health to loose an arrow whose damage grows with the life you sacrifice, plus a spell damage bonus. Painful, effective. 75 energy, 8 s cooldown.
spell.blood_infused_arrow.name: Blood Infused Arrow
spell.cataclysm.description: Calls down a 12 s vortex of 5 m radius that grinds everything inside for 40 damage plus 25x spell damage. The island's loudest apology. 500 energy, 300 s cooldown.
spell.cataclysm.name: Cataclysm
spell.firebolt.description: Lobs a quick fire bolt for 1.2x spell damage, igniting what it hits. The first spell every survivor learns, and the one they never stop using. 45 energy, 20 s cooldown.
spell.firebolt.name: Firebolt
spell.focus.description: Steady your breath: headshots hit +50% harder and body shots +15%, slowing aimed targets by 80% for 4 s. 40 energy, 20 s cooldown.
spell.focus.name: Focus
spell.frenzy.description: Free to cast. Each hit stacks +2% attack speed and +7.5% damage, up to 5 stacks, until you stop swinging. 0 energy, 40 s cooldown.
spell.frenzy.name: Frenzy
spell.golden_skin.description: Plates your body in living gold for a stretch of near-invulnerable armor. Slow, shiny, hard to kill. 65 energy, 160 s cooldown.
spell.golden_skin.name: Golden Skin
spell.healing_dome.description: Raises a glowing dome for 10 s that mends everyone standing inside it. A moving field hospital, if the patients stay put. 80 energy, 70 s cooldown.
spell.healing_dome.name: Healing Dome
spell.magic_arrow.description: Looses one huge arcane bolt dealing 4.2x spell damage, with a 10 s lingering effect. Perks can turn it into a volley. 100 energy, 20 s cooldown.
spell.magic_arrow.name: Magic Arrow
spell.multishot.description: Toggle: every shot fans into extra projectiles at a 25% damage penalty each. Drains 30 energy per use, and gear can add more arrows. 12 s cooldown.
spell.multishot.name: Multishot
spell.parry.description: Counter an incoming blow within 3.5 m for 40 damage plus 3x spell damage, then gain +1 attack speed for 10 s. 35 energy, 60 s cooldown.
spell.parry.name: Parry
spell.portal.description: Tears a doorway through the island that stays open for 30 s, letting you and your companions cross it freely. 90 energy, 60 s cooldown.
spell.portal.name: Portal
spell.purge.description: Cleanses debuffs from everything within 30 m. Perks make it heal you or amplify your damage for a time. 40 energy, 16 s cooldown.
spell.purge.name: Purge
spell.roaring_cheeks.description: A thunderous blast of foul wind: 30 m radius, hard knockback, 80% slow for 30 s and 50 base damage plus 5x spell damage. Nobody wins. 400 energy, 360 s cooldown.
spell.roaring_cheeks.name: Roaring Cheeks
spell.seeking_arrow.description: Fires a homing arrow that finds its mark for 10 s, deals +50% on headshots and slows its victim by 90% for 4 s. 50 energy, 5 s cooldown.
spell.seeking_arrow.name: Seeking Arrow
spell.snap_freeze.description: Flash-freezes enemies within 12 m for 7 s and deals 6.5x spell damage as they shatter against the cold. 220 energy, 40 s cooldown.
spell.snap_freeze.name: Snap Freeze
spell.snow_storm.description: Summons a whirling blizzard that chews through enemies in its area, scaling x0.4 with spell damage per charge, up to 10 charges. 120 energy, 20 s cooldown.
spell.snow_storm.name: Snow Storm
spell.sun_flare.description: Hurls a false sun that burns for 20 s over an 8.5 m area: enemies inside are slowed by 40% and scorched, while allies are mended. 100 energy, 70 s cooldown.
spell.sun_flare.name: Sun Flare
spell.sustain_shield.description: Channel to build a barrier at 3 points per second, up to a cap of 15, which lingers 20 s after you stop. Drains 50 energy for every second held.
spell.sustain_shield.name: Sustain Shield
spell.taunt.description: Insults everything in earshot so it charges you instead of your friends. Great way to hold a line, or lose one. 40 energy, 45 s cooldown.
spell.taunt.name: Taunt
spell.war_cry.description: A bellow across 50 m that rallies you and nearby allies: 20% more attack speed and 20% more damage for the duration. 85 energy, 180 s cooldown.
spell.war_cry.name: War Cry
spell.wide_reach.description: A cheap reflex cast that extends your reach past arm's length. Fast enough to spam: 10 energy, 0.4 s cooldown.
spell.wide_reach.name: Wide Reach

ui.affixes.arcanecataclysm.description: Drags a humming blue column along with it for ten seconds. It slows and burns.
ui.affixes.blackhole.description: Opens a well of nothing near you. It pulls you in and burns the middle.
ui.affixes.blizzard.description: Carries its own weather: a freezing ring that slows and chills everything inside.
ui.affixes.chains.description: Throws a tether that holds you in place for a few seconds.
ui.affixes.firecataclysm.description: Drags a column of fire along with it for ten seconds.
ui.affixes.flare.description: Fires a flare that bursts over your head. It lights you up and burns.
ui.affixes.laser.description: Charges a thin red line, then burns a beam along it.
ui.affixes.meteor.description: Marks the ground where you stand. Seconds later something heavy falls out of the sky.
ui.affixes.radiance.description: Gives off a hard white heat. Stay out of the ring.
ui.affixes.trapper.description: Leaves snares around you. Step on one and you stay there.
ui.affixes.warp.description: Steps out of the air next to you from far away.

ui.sheet.tip.agility: Raises ranged damage and max energy.
ui.sheet.tip.armor: Physical damage reduction from armor = (armor ÷ (armor + 500))², so each point is worth less than the last.
ui.sheet.tip.armor_piercing: Flat armor your melee hits ignore on the target (ranged hits: {0}).
ui.sheet.tip.attack_speed: Change in how fast you swing and shoot.
ui.sheet.tip.block: Flat damage removed from every hit you take (after armor).
ui.sheet.tip.crit_chance: Chance that a hit is a critical hit.
ui.sheet.tip.crit_damage: Extra damage a critical hit deals on top of the normal hit.
ui.sheet.tip.dodge: Chance that an incoming hit misses you completely.
ui.sheet.tip.health_on_hit: Health you recover every time one of your hits lands.
ui.sheet.tip.health_regen: (0.25% of max health + flat regen) × regen rate × recovery multiplier, on top of the game's own regeneration.
ui.sheet.tip.intelligence: Raises spell damage and energy recovery.
ui.sheet.tip.magic_find: Raises the rarity of items that drop.
ui.sheet.tip.magic_reduction: 1 − damage taken multiplier × magic damage taken multiplier. Armor does not apply to magic.
ui.sheet.tip.massacre_time: How long a kill streak lasts after a kill (longest wait). Each kill adds {0}s; the banked XP pays out when it runs out.
ui.sheet.tip.max_energy: (100 + Agility × energy per point + flat bonuses) × max energy multiplier. Spells spend it.
ui.sheet.tip.max_health: (100 + Vitality × health per point + flat bonuses) × max health multiplier.
ui.sheet.tip.melee_damage: All-damage × melee bonus × (1 + Strength × melee damage per Strength). Multiplies the weapon's base damage.
ui.sheet.tip.move_speed: Change in how fast you walk and run.
ui.sheet.tip.physical_reduction: 1 − damage taken multiplier × (1 − armor reduction). What you do not take from physical hits.
ui.sheet.tip.ranged_damage: All-damage × ranged bonus × (1 + Agility × ranged damage per Agility). Bows, guns and thrown weapons.
ui.sheet.tip.spell_damage: All-damage × spell bonus × (1 + Intelligence × spell damage per Intelligence).
ui.sheet.tip.strength: Raises melee damage (1 + Strength × the melee bonus per point). Each level also adds attribute points.
ui.sheet.tip.thorns: Damage reflected to the enemy that hits you in melee.
ui.sheet.tip.vitality: Raises max health (base 100 + Vitality × health per point, then the max health multiplier).
